payload.text: **ST0008 WP05, sleeve env for tool prefixes:** publish UTILZ_INSTALL_PREFIX (and any other declared tool prefix) to shells through Molt's one env writer (~/.config/molt/env.sh, plus the plist and environment.d the claude liberator already writes for CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR), declared once in vars.sh as "$MOLT_OPT_DIR/utilz" on rhadamanth. Must be live before Utilz 2.14.3 is cut (utilz-vc's ask, 24 Oct). The same writer is the natural answer to hv's launchd PATH question (todo 25).
